race.description: Mid Coast Automotive Country Boosted Hcp (Bm58)
race.comment: WHOOPI DO (1) filled a placing two runs back over this course and distance then was extended to 1750m last start and found that beyond her. Tackles whet looks an easier race today and returns to her preferred distance. Great chance to bounce back to form. KENISIS (9) took eight runs but finally cracked the maiden win last time out, quickening in good style through the final stages over 1500m at Muswellbrook. Has a tricky gate to contend with but if things go right she should be right in the thick of things again. PURPLE KITTY (3) made a rare visit to the winner's enclosure recently, picking up a BM58 over 2000m at Port Macquarie. Has won here at the trip and with his confidence back another big run is on the cards. CARMINE (4) has done his best work late in both runs this time in work, the latest over 1450m at Kempsey. New to this trip but it looks the right move on what we have seen lately. CLENCH (2) was outclassed first-up in open company. Can do a lot better.
